integrity: Proof steps and exact rational checker inspected within same-model scientific review; independent validation not performed. Finite checking does not prove the uniform limit.
limitations: Unweighted real equispaced quadratic orthogonal projection and adjacent total-variation seminorm only; higher degrees, irregular grids and stochastic risk not covered. Historical priority is not exhaustively certified.
title: Sharp bounded-variation amplification and jump localization for quadratic least-squares projection
